name: Community — MiniMax H3-Image Character Sheets
author: michaeldune
description:
Model format: int8 ConvRot. Steps: 6 by default.

Character reference sheets from one picture with MiniMax's open-weight H3-Image model, one card per layout: five views, four views, turnaround, a single full body, six head angles, seven views with hands and feet, the outfit laid flat, all thirteen views, and a sheet for animals and mascots. Each card makes a 16-megapixel sheet on a white background. The layouts come from ukr8b3g-cmyk's H3 Character Sheet Designer for ComfyUI. Uses the same model files as the MiniMax H3-Image pack (no prompt writer). Needs SimpliGen's engine at ComfyUI v0.45.0 or newer.

presets.name: H3-Image Sheet: Five Views
presets.tagline: Front and side portraits plus the full body from the front, side and back
presets.description:
Turns one picture of a character into a reference sheet on a white background: a front portrait, a side portrait, then the full body from the front, the side and the back. The prompt box is only for extra notes (for example: anime style, or bare feet).

Picture 1 is the character. A full-body picture keeps the whole outfit; with a head-and-shoulders picture the clothes below are invented.

The sheet is always 6272x2528 (about 16 megapixels); the aspect-ratio setting is not used. About 70-90 seconds per sheet on a 12 GB card.

The layout comes from ukr8b3g-cmyk's H3 Character Sheet Designer (v1.5.0) for ComfyUI. The built-in brief goes straight to the model with the picture, without the prompt writer.

What to type: nothing, or a few words of extra notes such as a style or one detail to change (anime style, bare feet). The character comes from Picture 1 and the sheet adds the views, poses and background, so do not describe the character, camera, lighting, composition or setting.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: Weights from Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image (commit 0bb149f): the 33B H3-Image transformer, pruned int8 (21.0 GB) and its single-frame VAE (1.2 GB); the 32B nvfp4 text encoder (15.7 GB) is the one the H3 video packs already use. No prompt writer: the layout brief (plus the user's notes on a new line) and picture 1 go straight into MiniMaxH3ImageConditioning, as in ukr8b3g-cmyk/H3-Character-Sheet-Designer (MIT). The brief is our own wording of the Designer's layout (the Designer's own prompt for this view preset gave extra or missing panels in our tests); the canvas (6272x2528) is the Designer's Auto canvas for the preset scaled to ~16 MP. Picture 1 is scaled to 4 MP (multiple of 32). 6 steps, cfg 1, euler/simple, zeroed negative. User LoRA slot as on the other H3-Image cards.

presets.name: H3-Image Sheet: Outfit Front and Back
presets.tagline: The character's outfit laid flat, front and back, with no one wearing it
presets.description:
Takes the outfit from a picture of a character and lays it out flat on a white background, front and back side by side, with no person in it. The prompt box is only for extra notes.

Picture 1 is the character wearing the outfit, best as a full-body picture. Parts of the outfit the picture does not show are invented.

This is the least reliable layout: in our tests about half the sheets came out clean, and the others had one fault, such as a garment drawn twice, a long coat drawn short, or the hair left in with goggles or a hat. Run it again with another seed when that happens.

The sheet is always 3712x4256 (about 16 megapixels); the aspect-ratio setting is not used. About 70-90 seconds per sheet on a 12 GB card.

The layout comes from ukr8b3g-cmyk's H3 Character Sheet Designer (v1.5.0) for ComfyUI. The built-in brief goes straight to the model with the picture, without the prompt writer.

presets.name: H3-Image Sheet: Animal or Mascot
presets.tagline: Eleven views of an animal or mascot character that wears no clothes
presets.description:
A reference sheet for animal characters and mascots without clothes: six head angles, three full-body views in the character's own stance, and close-ups of the paws or hands and the feet. It keeps the fur, markings, colours and body shape of the picture instead of dressing the character. The prompt box is only for extra notes.

Picture 1 is the animal or mascot, best as a full-body picture.

The sheet is always 7264x2176 (about 16 megapixels); the aspect-ratio setting is not used. About 70-90 seconds per sheet on a 12 GB card.

The layout comes from ukr8b3g-cmyk's H3 Character Sheet Designer (v1.5.0) for ComfyUI. The built-in brief goes straight to the model with the picture, without the prompt writer.
